summary: Interparfums, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting the results of its September 15, 2026 annual meeting of stockholders and related press release. Stockholders elected eight directors to one-year terms, including Valerie Hermann and Benedicte Epinay, approved, on an advisory basis, named executive officer compensation, and approved a ten-year extension of the 2026 Stock Option Plan through June 27, 2036. No special-situation transaction, tender, strategic review, or forced management change was disclosed. The filing is a routine meeting-results and other-events current report, so no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply.
